name: Eden Dwyer
title: Psychologist
description: Registered psychologist who is trans and neurodivergent, offering trauma-informed, neuro-affirming, sex-positive, and gender and sexuality-affirming care. Focus areas include gender dysphoria, autism and ADHD, trauma and dissociation; methods include somatic work, EMDR, parts work, DBT, ACT and CBT.
specialties: trans, gender dysphoria, queer-affirming, trauma, dissociation, EMDR, parts work, sex-positive, neurodivergent

name: Brydan Xavier
title: Psychologist
description: Has an interest working with gender, sexuality, sex and intimacy issues, trauma, and men's mental health. Utilises an eclectic mix of therapy styles including CBT, ACT, DBT and EMDR (standard and 2.0); gender- and neuro-affirming. A member of the LGBTIQA+ community.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, gender, sexuality, sex and intimacy, LGBTIQA+, men's mental health

name: Scott Jordan
title: Psychologist
description: Online-only psychologist with a focus on Dissociative Disorders (DID), Trauma and PTSD, and LGBTQ+ clients.
specialties: dissociative disorders, DID, trauma, PTSD, LGBTQ+

name: Dr Elizabeth (Liz) Jervis
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical psychologist on the Mornington Peninsula working with adolescents and adults, with particular interests in EMDR, attachment, dissociation, and trauma-focused therapy, including complex trauma. Listed issues include Dissociative Identity Disorder and PTSD.
specialties: EMDR, dissociation, Dissociative Identity Disorder, trauma, complex trauma, attachment, PTSD, DBT, ACT

name: Dr Emily Incledon
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Works with trauma-related experiences using trauma-focused therapies and EMDR, which is at the core of her approach. Holds accredited training in EMDR, Schema Therapy, Prolonged Exposure and CBT-I; co-founder of Lumify Health offering EMDR intensives.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, PTSD, Schema Therapy, sexual abuse survivors, ACT, CBT

name: Melita Rossa
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical psychologist in private practice in Eltham, Melbourne, also offering telehealth Australia-wide. Melita's work is underpinned by scientifically supported therapies including Schema Therapy, EMDR, ACT and CBT.
specialties: Schema Therapy, EMDR, ACT, CBT, adult ADHD and autism assessment

name: Ashwini Anand
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Ash is a Clinical Psychologist offering therapy sessions in Melbourne and Australia-wide, grounded in trauma-informed and neuroaffirming principles. Ash integrates trauma-informed therapy, Schema Therapy, Internal Family Systems, and the PACE model, working with adults experiencing complex trauma, eating disorders, ADHD, ASD and OCD.
specialties: complex trauma, Schema Therapy, Internal Family Systems, personality disorders, eating disorders, neuroaffirming
